## How the book is organized {.unnumbered}

The book has four parts: foundations, describing networks, modeling networks and
practice. Each chapter opens with what it assumes and closes with exercises and
a summary.

## Two languages, for now {.unnumbered}

Every example appears in R and Python. On the website, choose a language once
and every example follows. In the printed book the versions are shown one after
another. They give the same answers, because they call the same engine. More
languages will be added later.
